description: Election Commission - S. A. George was Selected as the member of the Balangoda Urban Council U. R. S. S. Gunathilaka was Selected as the member of Nivithigala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government councils (Balangoda Urban Council and Nivithigala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of selected members to fill positions that became vacant due to party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and local authority member appointments.
